full_description:
WordPress Website Design & Development — Foshan Direct

Project Overview

Foshan Direct ([login to view URL]) is an upcoming furniture procurement and sourcing business that aggregates furniture catalogs from various sourcing partners into a single platform for international buyers. The target audience is primarily interior designers and architects across the US and Europe looking to source furniture through one point of contact.

The site is a new build — there is no existing website or brand identity yet. The freelancer will be proposing the visual direction as part of this project.

Scope of Work

• Build a WordPress website presenting furniture catalogs sourced from various suppliers as a single, unified product catalog — there is no public supplier listing or per-supplier branded pages. Products are presented under the Foshan Direct catalog only.

• Product browsing with categories and filters (e.g., furniture type, material, room/use case).

• Quote/RFQ (Request for Quote) system in place of direct checkout — designers and architects submit inquiries per product or project rather than buying online.

• All enquiries route to Foshan Direct only — never to individual suppliers. There should be no supplier contact details or branding visible to site visitors.

• RFQ form should capture relevant project details: quantity, specifications, shipping destination, and timeline.


• Overall design and copy tone should read as professional, trade-focused B2B — built for designers and architects sourcing internationally, not a consumer storefront.

Pages Needed
• Homepage
• How It Works
• Product catalog / listing pages (aggregated, not grouped by supplier)
• Pricing
• General Terms & Conditions
• RFQ / Request a Quote form
• Contact information page
• Blog or Resources section (optional, for design trends / sourcing guides)
 Arrange a visit to Foshan

Technical Requirements

• WordPress CMS with a premium, professional theme (freelancer to recommend — Elementor, Astra, Divi, or similar page-builder compatible).

• Catalog structure should let admin import/add products from various sourcing partners into one unified, browsable catalog — supplier identity stays internal/admin-only, not shown publicly. Freelancer to propose the best plugin/setup for this (e.g., custom post types/taxonomies, or a catalog-mode WooCommerce setup with checkout disabled).

• RFQ/contact form integration (e.g., WPForms, Gravity Forms) with email notifications routed to Foshan Direct's admin email only.

• Fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile.

• Basic on-page SEO setup (meta titles/descriptions, sitemap, clean URLs).

• Optimized for fast loading (compressed images, caching-friendly setup).

• CMS access so products/catalog items can be added or updated after launch without developer help.

• Site architecture should be built to allow AR/VR product visualization tools to be plugged in later (e.g., WebAR viewers or 3D/AR model support on product pages). Not required to build this phase — just should not be architected in a way that blocks adding it down the line.
Deliverables

• Fully functional, launch-ready WordPress site per the scope above.

• Admin ability to add/manage catalog products from various sourcing partners.

• Working RFQ/quote request functionality with email notifications to Foshan Direct.

• Responsive design tested across devices.

• Basic SEO setup.

• Short handover documentation/guide on adding new products to the catalog post-launch.

• One round of revisions included.

Timeline: 6 weeks from kickoff to launch-ready handover.

How to Apply

• Share portfolio examples of WordPress builds — ideally catalog-style or B2B/trade sites.
• Propose your recommended theme/plugin stack for the unified catalog + RFQ setup.
• Confirm your rate and turnaround time within the budget and timeline above.
• Note any experience with AR/VR or 3D product viewer integrations (e.g., WebAR, model-viewer, Shopify/WordPress AR plugins) — a plus, though not required for this phase.

full_description:
Project Title: Multi-Batch Test Series Web App for Government Exam Coaching (React + Firebase)
Project Description:
We need a web-based test series application for an exam coaching institute (Sigma Academy) preparing students for Maharashtra government recruitment exams (Police Bharti, SSC GD, Forest Guard/Vanrakshak — with room to add more batches later).
Core Features Required:
Student login/signup via Firebase Authentication (mobile OTP)
Multi-batch selection system — students see only their enrolled batch(es)
Test Series module: Subject-wise tests, Full-length mock tests (auto-generated by randomly pulling questions per subject to total 100 marks), Previous year papers, Bilingual (Marathi/English) support
Timed test-taking screen with question navigation grid, auto-submit
Instant result screen: score, correct/incorrect answers, subject-wise performance analysis
Maharashtra-wide and district-wise ranking/leaderboard after test deadline
PDF notes section linked to Google Drive, batch-wise
Live lecture section (embedded YouTube/Zoom links)
Razorpay payment integration for batch enrollment
Admin-side bulk question upload from Google Sheets to Firestore database
Dynamic dashboard menu (config-driven, so new modules can be added later without code changes)
Tech Stack (preferred):
Frontend: React
Backend/Database: Firebase Authentication + Firestore
Hosting: Vercel or Netlify
Version control: GitHub
Payment: Razorpay
Content storage: Google Sheets (questions), Google Drive (PDFs)
Custom domain integration
Deliverables:
Fully functional, deployed web app on custom domain
Source code on GitHub (client will own the repository)
Basic documentation on how to add new questions/batches via Google Sheets
Timeline: . 3-4 weeks
Budget: , please quote
Additional Notes: Please share similar past projects (test series apps, quiz platforms, or coaching institute apps) in your proposal.
